label: Customer Complaint Root Cause Analyzer
description: Analyzes patterns in customer complaint data to identify systemic issues, process failures, and product deficiencies. Prioritizes remediation actions by frequency and impact.

guidedInputs.label: Complaint data or summary
guidedInputs.description: Paste anonymised complaint data, a summary table, or a description of complaint patterns.
guidedInputs.placeholder:
e.g., Q1 2025 complaint summary — Total: 342 complaints.

Category | Count | % | Avg resolution days
Payment delay | 98 | 29% | 8.2
Inaccurate charges | 74 | 22% | 12.1
Account closure complaints | 52 | 15% | 15.6
KYC/onboarding friction | 41 | 12% | 21.3
Service quality (branch) | 77 | 22% | 5.4

Sample complaints (anonymised):
C1: Customer charged twice for same transaction, 4 days to resolve, no proactive contact
C2: Account closure without advance notice, customer had automatic payments set up...

guidedInputs.label: Context and prior analysis (optional)
guidedInputs.description: Any known issues, recent system changes, or prior root cause work that is relevant.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., New core banking system migrated in November 2024. Complaints have increased 28% vs Q1 2024. Management believes payment delay complaints are related to the migration but no root cause has been confirmed.

guidedInputs.label: Regulatory context
guidedInputs.description: Are there regulatory reporting thresholds or FOS/ombudsman escalation patterns to consider?
